title: Lens mother-tongue peek response
description: The object the model is asked to return inside choices[0].message.content. One English word in, one line out in the mother tongue the request was made in: the bubble draws it whole while the reader holds the globe, so nothing second may be asked for and nothing may arrive a piece at a time.

results.description: Exactly one entry: the whole message is one item. No echoed title; the app stamps the asked-for word onto the result.

line.description: The word's most likely meaning, one short line, in the mother tongue.
